figures.public_caption: Ligand-class cartoons distinguish L-type donors, Z-type acceptors and X-type bonding. CdSe illustrates several exchange/displacement patterns; the separate NC(X)2 displacement is identified with oxide systems such as HfO2, not all nanocrystals.

figures.public_caption: A catalytic ester-exchange test uses HfO2 particles for two hours at 130 C, not their synthesis conditions. NMR and HMBC identify four ester species; NOESY supports bound alcohol/oleic-acid populations, whereas the ester signal shows zero-quantum coherence.
